admissionRule: H-REGULATION receives only scoped support if INDEPENDENT_FEEDBACK materially lowers false capitalization versus both LOCAL and SHAM_EXTRA while not increasing false holds on positive controls, and the direction survives both model families or a preregistered cross-model aggregate with no opposing model effect.
authorityBoundary: Computing-only read of historical evidence. No mutation of Runtime, Host, Harness, World, Workstation, Finance, Security, Game, Web, Studio or Human.
budget: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro; 8 cases x 3 treatments x 2 models x 2 replicas = 96 logical slots. Same no-tool Harness budget and max output across treatments.
decisionQuestion: Should this change be capitalized into future rounds as an accepted reusable mechanism/prior/capability at its evidenced scope, or remain candidate-only / unpromoted?
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If independent feedback adds no discriminating value, or merely induces blanket conservatism, do not proceed to repeated-round F7B on the claim that regulation improves retention selection.
developmentSplit: multi-participant adaptation trap; CEL selection-policy positive; global-method trap; CEL prerequisite-policy positive.
evidenceSelection: Eight real Ordivon change episodes: four local-success traps whose later independent evidence blocked/generalized-down promotion, and four positive controls whose later independent evidence supported scoped capitalization. Development and holdout each contain two traps and two positives.
holdoutSplit: Bedrock scaffold trap; Web P5 render-review positive; richer-scaffold trap; ACS Workstation surface positive.
independentOracle: Canonical later research disposition/owner acceptance from exact retained Ordivon evidence. Oracle is hidden from Provider and is not generated by F7A.
invalidityConditions: oracle/disposition text appears in LOCAL or SHAM packet
independent addendum is edited after first Provider call
case/replica count changes after observed result
invalid structured Provider output is scored as a semantic miss
SHAM addendum directly states independent holdout/regression/production outcome
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: INDEPENDENT_FEEDBACK: LOCAL plus one independent holdout/regression/reproduction result from the historical record. No generic PAL law, scoring service, or learned policy is added.
mission: Test whether independent out-of-sample/owner-native regulation evidence prevents false capitalization of locally promising adaptive changes without suppressing changes that survive independent verification.
publicationBoundary: F7A may update Computing PAL hypotheses only. It cannot create a regulation layer, evaluator service, PAL controller, or owner promotion policy.
questionOrHypothesis: Does explicit independent feedback improve capitalization decisions beyond local evidence or an equal-length non-discriminating evidence addendum?
rollbackRule: Research-only files and temporary Harness state.
stopRule: Stop after all 96 slots terminate. Compare exact capitalization, false capitalization on traps, false hold on positives, structured validity, token cost, and strict both-valid paired comparisons. No F7A v2 tuning on these cases.
strongBaseline: LOCAL: only evidence available from local/development behavior before independent evaluation
SHAM_EXTRA: LOCAL plus case-specific same-family descriptive detail of comparable text length that does not reveal independent outcome
